messages.subject: unit-test failure in Jenkins
parts:
I'm hunting it down. I upgraded the Jenkins version recently and it looks like they changed the way they pick up error codes from the command line. The last couple pull request might have had been accepted without passing tests (#116, #117). If they don't pass, I will have to revert them and new pull requests will have to be made. I'll send a link to directions on how to fix reverted pull requests if that happens.


Daniel
